text: Understood: the app didn't tell you about the last update. How updates reach you: the app checks GitHub every 15 min in the background (and every time you open it) and posts the notification; Android can delay that background check on a Moto G when battery optimization or Doze is on. That's likely why v0.114.6 never pinged you. v0.114.7 (the +EV books-agree filters, ParlayAPI paid key first, dead-man switch) is building now (~5 min). When it's out I'll also send a high-priority message through the chat/messages channel as a second route, and you can force it any time: open the app and it checks on open. To make the background check reliable: Android Settings > Apps > Vigilant > Battery > Unrestricted. If you meant something else by '0.114.7' (e.g. what version the app shows), tell me.
